According to Wikipedia:Nimrod, Nimrod is a Mesopotamian monarch mentioned in the Thora, the Bible, and the Qur'an. He is depicted as a mighty ruler and nation builder who founded many cities, including
Babylon and the Tower of Babel. In the Bible, he is described as the son of Cush, grandson of Ham, greatgrandson of Noah. Nimrod is said to be the founder and king of the first empire after the Flood. Several
Sumerian ruins preserve Nimrod's name.
